claims.text: A clinician note from 2 June 2026 records continuing lisinopril 10 mg daily, with blood pressure at target.

citations.quote: Continue lisinopril 10 mg daily; blood pressure at target.

claims.text: A later clinician note from 12 August 2026 records stopping lisinopril because of a dry cough and starting losartan 50 mg daily.

citations.quote: Stop lisinopril because of a dry cough. Start losartan 50 mg daily.

claims.text: The record contains a medication conflict for lisinopril, described as hold versus take.

open_questions: The record does not answer when lisinopril was first recorded other than the 2 June 2026 entry; was there an earlier start entry?
The record contains the 12 August 2026 instruction to start losartan 50 mg daily, but whether it was actually started and confirmed later is not documented.
The record does not document the dry cough's onset date or its timing relative to lisinopril beyond the 12 August 2026 note.
No earlier entry documenting a hold or stop of lisinopril is present; the source of the hold-versus-take conflict is unresolved.
The most recent blood pressure values are not given; the 2 June 2026 note only states blood pressure was at target.
No follow-up appointment, referral or repeat blood pressure check after the 12 August 2026 switch is documented.
No allergies or allergic reactions are recorded in the provided entries.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Lisinopril appears as both continued (2 June 2026) and stopped (12 August 2026), and a medication conflict for lisinopril (hold versus take) is flagged; unclear current status.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Clinician to reconcile the lisinopril conflict and confirm the current medication list, including whether losartan 50 mg daily was started.
